issues: The dashboard title 'EcoStream Live' is repeated twice in the source code. The first instance should be removed.
The 'Total Collected' card displays a static value of '148.6 Tons' instead of dynamically calculating it from the data.
The 'Recovery Rate' card calculates recovery rate incorrectly by counting non-null disposal dates, which does not accurately reflect the recovery rate.
The 'Hazardous Neut.' card calculates hazardous waste incorrectly by filtering items with isHazardous set to true and summing their quantities, which may include non-hazardous items.
The 'Carbon Offset' card calculates carbon offset incorrectly by assuming all disposed items contribute 1.2 MT of CO2e, which does not reflect the actual carbon offset calculation.
The 'Stream Inflow vs Recycled Volume' section displays a button with an icon but no content or functionality.
The 'Material Composition' and 'Live Stream Activity' sections are empty and need to be populated with appropriate content based on the data.
